content_sections.heading: CONCOR Recruitment 2026 Pay Scale & CTC
content_sections.text: Management Trainees undergo one year of on-the-job and off-the-job training and, on successful completion, are absorbed in the Assistant Manager grade/E1. Selected MT candidates must execute a service bond of ₹2 Lakhs plus 12% interest per annum, to serve CONCOR for a minimum of three years (excluding the training period).

content_sections.heading: CONCOR Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Management Trainee: Computer Based Test (CBT), followed by Group Discussion and/or Interview, as decided by CONCOR. CONCOR's decision is final and binding. Assistant Officer: Selection is purely based on performance in the Online Test (CBT) – there is no GD or interview stage for this post. No correspondence will be entertained for non-calling of a candidate for the Online Test/GD/Interview, or for non-selection. Duration: 90 minutes total (120 minutes for eligible PwBD candidates availing a scribe). Negative marking: 1/4 (0.25) mark deducted for each wrong answer. Each question has 5 answer choices. The question paper is set in English and Hindi only; the English version prevails in case of any discrepancy. Candidates opt for 3 Test Cities in order of preference at the time of application; this cannot be changed after submission. CONCOR reserves the right to cancel or add examination centres at its discretion.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CONCOR Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the CONCOR website concorindia.co.in and go to 'HR & Career Section → Recruitment and Result'. Before starting, keep a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number ready and active till the process completes – create a new e-mail ID first if you don't have one. Fill in the online application form as per the instructions provided on the portal and pay the applicable fee online. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application form with the prescribed fee for each post code. Submit the application by 30 September 2026, 11:55 PM . No other mode of application (offline/postal) is accepted. Registration number, password, e-Admit Card, Call Letter for Document Verification/GD/Interview and other communication will be sent only to the registered e-mail ID/SMS – check your spam/junk folder as well. Important: Applications received without the prescribed fee, required documents and information are liable to be rejected. Fee once paid is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any future recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee & Documents Required
content_sections.text: Fee is accepted online only; bank transaction/intimation charges are borne by the candidate. Documents to be produced in original at the time of document verification (for candidates who qualify the CBT) include: All educational qualification certificates and mark sheets (final mark sheet/degree, if provisionally applied while in the final year/semester) Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL, in the prescribed proforma; OBC-NCL certificate not older than 1 year) Disability certificate from the Competent Authority, for PwBD reservation/relaxation (40% or more disability) Income and Asset Certificate, not older than 1 year, for EWS reservation Defence Service Certificate from the Competent Authority, for Ex-servicemen candidates No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the current employer, for candidates already employed on a regular basis in Government/Semi-Government/PSU/Autonomous Bodies A notarized English or Hindi translation, if any SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/EWS certificate is issued in another language

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: CONCOR does not undertake detailed scrutiny of eligibility at the application/CBT stage – candidature is accepted only provisionally; candidates must satisfy themselves of their eligibility before applying. If claims of qualification/caste/category made in the application are not substantiated by documents at verification, the candidature will be cancelled; furnishing wrong or false information, or suppressing information, leads to disqualification and, even if appointed, termination of service. If the candidate's identity is in doubt, or requisite documents cannot be produced, or there is a mismatch in document information, the candidate will not be allowed to appear for Document Verification and the candidature is liable to be cancelled. Selected candidates are liable to be posted at any office/terminal/unit of CONCOR at any location, at the company's sole discretion, and liable to transfer anywhere thereafter. If marks in the qualifying exam are in CGPA terms, they should not be lower than 7 points on a 10-point scale, or the equivalent percentage, and not less than the prescribed percentage for the respective post. Where a Management/Engineering qualification has dual specialization, one specialization must be function-specific to the post advertised. Experience requirements must be in the areas specified in the post's job specification; there is no experience requirement for ex-servicemen candidates. No travelling expenses are paid for the online test or Group Discussion; candidates appearing for interview get travel expense reimbursement as per CONCOR's TA/DA rules. Canvassing in any form disqualifies the candidate. Appointment is subject to verification of original documents (age, qualification, experience, caste), police verification, reference checks, and fitness in the Medical Fitness Test conducted by CONCOR's Medical Authorities. Management has the right to cancel the recruitment at any point without notice, and the number of posts may increase or decrease at CONCOR's sole discretion. In case of any ambiguity from interpretation in a version other than English, the English version prevails. Any dispute regarding this recruitment will be settled within the jurisdiction of Delhi only.

faq.question: Q1. What is the name of the organisation conducting CONCOR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Container Corporation of India Limited (CONCOR) is conducting the recruitment process.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are released under CONCOR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 77 vacancies have been announced for Management Trainee and Assistant Officer posts.

faq.question: Q3. What posts are available in CONCOR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts include Management Trainee (C&O, Accounts, Accounts/Compliance, Technical, MIS, Civil, P&A) and Assistant Officer (C&O, Accounts, Technical, MIS, Civil).

faq.question: Q4. What is the starting date to apply online for CONCOR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process will start from 31 August 2026 at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for CONCOR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 30 September 2026 up to 11:55 PM.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: 18–28 years for Management Trainee and 18–32 years for Assistant Officer (as on 31.08.2026, for UR category), with age relaxation for SC/ST, OBC-NCL, PwBD, Ex-servicemen and departmental candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Management Trainee: CBT followed by GD and/or Interview. Assistant Officer: selection is purely based on CBT performance, with no GD or interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the CTC for these posts?
faq.answer: Approximately ₹20.11 Lakhs per annum for Management Trainee and ₹16.09 Lakhs per annum for Assistant Officer.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: ₹750 + GST for Management Trainee and ₹500 + GST for Assistant Officer (General/OBC/EWS candidates); SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-servicemen candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a service bond for Management Trainee?
faq.answer: Yes – selected MT candidates must execute a service bond of ₹2 Lakhs plus 12% interest per annum to serve CONCOR for a minimum of 3 years, excluding the training period.
